title: Basis of the Rate Lock Commitment Relock Fee by Time Lapsed Since Expiration
content:
### Fee basis of a Rate Lock Commitment relock fee

The relock fee points are built on a fee basis.

**Lapsed days.** The lapsed days are the calendar days from the expiration date the lock carried when it expired to the date of its latest relock request. That expiration date is the new expiration date of its latest extension, or its original expiration date when it was never extended.

**Rule.**

- When the lapsed days are no more than the back-dating grace of **7** days, and the lock still has extension days left under its cumulative extension limit, the fee basis is the lapsed days priced as an extension. That is the lapsed days times the lock's extension cost per day, in basis points, divided by 100, rounded to three decimal places.
- When the lapsed days are more than the late-relock days of **21**, the fee basis is the lock's relock fee points plus the late-relock adder of **0.125** points.
- Otherwise the fee basis is the lock's relock fee points.

"Extension days left" means the extension days booked on the lock add up to less than the product's maximum cumulative extension days.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Maximum cumulative extension days | Extension cost per day (basis points) | Relock fee points |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 15 | 2.5 | 0.125 |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 2.0 | 0.125 |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 2.0 | 0.125 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 2.0 | 0.125 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 2.5 | 0.250 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 45 | 3.0 | 0.250 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 60 | 3.0 | 0.250 |

### Hypothetical cases (Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock)

- Lapsed 5 days, 10 extension days used: 5 times 2.0 divided by 100, which is 0.100 points.
- Lapsed 7 days, but 30 extension days already used (no days left): the fee basis is the relock fee points, 0.125.
- Lapsed 21 days: the fee basis is the relock fee points, 0.125.
- Lapsed 22 days: 0.125 plus 0.125, which is 0.250 points.
